title: AttestationStation Explorer
tagline: This is an advanced attestation explorer that includes additional features
description:
This is an advanced attestation explorer built upon the original work by sbvegan

Web3 LinkedIn and an open source explorer for Optimism's AttestationStation -- a data primitive for making arbitrary attestations about Ethereum addresses to connect with professionals to connect.
how_its_made:
For the home page, we gather attestation data via calling an api from nxyz platform.

Feature Improvements
Multi-attestation using uploaded CSV (some basic validation included)
Search for attestaions using about, creator, key or transaction hash (makes use of nxyz API)
Home page for browsing recent attestations and key stats (makes use of nxyz API)

Graphin Web attestations visualizations for future work.
https://github.com/duguowei1000/graphin_visualizations
